author: Ryan Shirley
description: One of my favorite shots of all time 🐅 it was our last evening filming and we were taking a team selfie. Our guide looked behind us and there was a tiger about 100 meters away preparing to cross the river, we were able to film her leave the water perfectly lit up by the setting sun! I can’t believe the beauty of the tiger, world’s most beautiful animal. Filmed in 8K 🎥 #tiger #animals #wildlife
title: Can I retire after this shot? 🎥🐅
